bound_delayed_single_measurement.details: Requires a new output path, exact previously reviewed serial-controller hash and observer hash bound by the node plan. wait_until precedes every remote call. The main path performs CPU-before, ten-second local delay, one measurement of the registered task list, CPU-after, then one output write. wait_until only sleeps locally; it does not poll the server. There is no retry/restart loop.

cpu_program_and_formula.details: The exact generated CPU program compiles. busy_percent uses the delta of the first eight aggregate /proc/stat fields and subtracts idle plus iowait; guest counters are not counted again. Nonnegative deltas and positive total are required. Exact formula fixtures give0% idle-only,100% busy-only and50% mixed with large excluded guest deltas. This is aggregate logical-CPU activity, not per-process utilization.

raw_endpoint_preservation.details: The observer writes the complete measurement object and appends both raw CPU endpoints/timestamps, actual interval, calculated busy percent, node-plan path and node-plan hash. Original task identity/loss/progress/host-memory records, full meminfo_kib and gpu_csv remain present. CPU sampling brackets the measurement, so the saved interval includes SSH/snapshot overhead and may exceed10 seconds. Host/GPU fields are from one measurement call; they are not claimed simultaneous hardware samples.

unchanged_measurement_and_read_only_scop.details: The serial controller and complete_pipeline retain their sealed hashes. measurement still validates each registered RUNNING native PID, child command, contiguous completed CSV rows and finite logged losses, and reads smaps_rollup/meminfo and restricted nvidia-smi fields. remote is unchanged checked SSH with120-second timeout and JSON decoding. The new observer does not launch/stop training, read weights, modify source/plans remotely, or query temperature/power.

inert_main_flow.details: Exact main AST executed locally with inert wait/remote/measurement functions and a clearly marked synthetic24-task node. It made exactly two CPU reads and one measurement after the wait, retained raw fields exactly, stored the matching node hash, and recorded the actual13-second synthetic bracket interval. No remote command, NN invocation or wall-time wait was executed by this review.

scope: Bounded read-only source review of the capacity observer and the referenced unchanged measurement/remote/wait_until helpers. No real24-task resource endpoint, health verdict, training completion, accuracy or onlineFPS is certified.
runtime_requirements: The actual registered node plan must provide the intended24-task ownership list, exact observer hash, scheduled epoch and fresh output path.
The runtime observation still must pass the unchanged native identity/finite-loss checks.
For endpoint capacity reporting, consume the preserved snapshot meminfo_kib and gpu_csv; this observer does not change the existing score_health implementation.
